title: Extraordinary Life Stories with John Reynolds — Eric's episode airs Saturday 9:30 AM on Bloomberg TV
summary: John Reynolds — entrepreneur, investor and host of Extraordinary Life Stories — announces his episode with Eric, airing Saturday morning on Bloomberg TV (Sky 502) and on Spotify. Reynolds frames the draw as Eric's openness about failure rather than the success that followed it, which he says fits the show's premise of learning from the difficult parts rather than the highlight reel.
blockquote:
Yet Eric talks incredibly openly about failure.

About needing to get things wrong.

To learn.

Adapt.

Keep going.

His failures didn't prevent his success.

They helped create it.

There's a real alignment with the mission behind Extraordinary Life Stories.

Learning from the lived experiences of people who've been through the difficult bits, not just hearing about the success afterwards.
